info.name: Resource Booking API
info.description:
Backend API for booking shared resources with conflict detection and concurrency-safe reservations.

Setup: import this collection and the environment file, select the environment, set adminEmail/adminPassword (promote a user with UPDATE users SET role='admin' ...), then run the collection with the Collection Runner. Folders are meant to be run in order.
